description: This file defines the Card data structure and related methods for validation, population, and conversion to/from blocks within the focalboard project. It includes error handling, patching, and validation logic specific to card entities.

classes.name: ErrInvalidCard
classes.description: Custom error type for invalid card errors, holding an error message.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Represents a content card with properties like ID, BoardID, Title, ContentOrder, Icon, Properties, timestamps, and deletion status.

classes.name: CardPatch
classes.description: Structure for partial updates to a Card, including optional fields for Title, ContentOrder, Icon, and Properties.

methods.name: NewErrInvalidCard
methods.description: Creates a new ErrInvalidCard with a specified message.

methods.name: Error (ErrInvalidCard)
methods.description: Returns the error message string for ErrInvalidCard.

methods.name: Error (ErrInvalidFieldType)
methods.description: Returns the error message string for ErrInvalidFieldType.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates a Card with default ID, timestamps, and initializes slices and maps if nil.

methods.name: PopulateWithBoardID
methods.description: Sets the BoardID of the Card and populates default values.

methods.name: CheckValid
methods.description: Validates the Card fields, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a CardPatch to a Card, updating its fields.

methods.name: CheckValid (CardPatch)
methods.description: Validates the CardPatch, especially the icon's grapheme count.

methods.name: Card2Block
methods.description: Converts a Card to a Block representation.

methods.name: Block2Card
methods.description: Converts a Block to a Card, extracting relevant fields and handling types.

methods.name: CardPatch2BlockPatch
methods.description: Converts a CardPatch to a BlockPatch for updates.
